jobs.title: Audio QA Lead
jobs.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for an Audio QA Lead to lead and develop our Audio QA capability within Shared Development. This is a central role supporting multiple projects at different stages of development, from early production through release and live updates. You will help projects deliver audio experiences that meet both technical requirements and creative intent. You will lead the Audio QA team, establish effective testing approaches, and work closely with project QA teams and partners across Audio, Development, Production, and Publishing. The Audio QA Lead contributes to project QA direction and owns Audio QA planning and execution within the discipline. You will balance the needs of individual projects with the opportunity to improve shared practices, visibility, and consistency across the studio. Responsibilities: Lead, mentor, and develop Audio Design QA Analysts, setting clear expectations, priorities, goals, and quality standards. Plan and coordinate Audio QA work across multiple projects, aligning coverage and resources with milestones, schedules, risks, and team capacity. Translate project QA direction into practical Audio QA strategies, test plans, coverage, and measurable quality expectations. Oversee testing across audio domains, including sound effects, music, dialogue, ambience, audio systems, and mixing. Ensure audio is evaluated for both technical functionality and creative goals, including gameplay readability, immersion, consistency, and emotional impact. Support the investigation of complex audio issues across assets, implementation, logic, and systems, using tools such as Wwise and Unreal Engine. Ensure audio issues are clearly reported, prioritized, followed up, and verified through resolution. Lead testing efforts for major audio features, establishing priorities, validation approaches, and suitable test environments. Maintain visibility of Audio QA status, coverage, risks, blockers, and readiness; provide reliable input to project milestone and release assessments. Identify quality risks, dependencies, and delivery concerns early, and work with project stakeholders to agree and follow through on mitigation plans. Collaborate with Sound Design, Music, Audio Programming, Development, Production, project QA, and Publishing to align quality expectations and drive solutions. Use testing results, issue trends, and stakeholder feedback to provide clear, data-informed quality recommendations. Improve Audio QA workflows, testing methodologies, tools, documentation, and reporting practices across projects. Support recruitment, onboarding, performance feedback, career development, and sustainable workload planning for the team. Share effective practices across projects and contribute to consistent Audio QA standards within Shared Development and the wider QA organization. Significant experience in game QA, audio, or a related development discipline, including responsibility for the quality of complex audio features throughout production. Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating QA professionals, with the ability to set clear priorities and support people’s development. Strong understanding of interactive game audio, including sound effects, ambience, music, dialogue, and how they work together during gameplay. A critical ear and the ability to evaluate audio beyond basic functionality, considering consistency, balance, creative intent, and player experience. Experience creating and maintaining test strategies, test plans, and structured coverage for complex features. Familiarity with audio middleware such as Wwise and game engines such as Unreal Engine, with the ability to investigate implementation-related issues. Ability to assess quality risks and player impact, prioritize issues, and communicate clear recommendations. Experience providing detailed, constructive, and actionable feedback to both creative and technical specialists. Strong organizational skills and the ability to coordinate work across multiple projects and stakeholders. Clear communication and collaboration skills, including the confidence to raise concerns, challenge plans constructively, and follow through on decisions. Strong spoken and written English. A proactive, accountable approach to problem-solving and continuous improvement. Nice to Have A professional background in Sound Design, Technical Sound Design, or Audio Implementation. Experience shipping at least one PC or console game. Strong understanding of audio production fundamentals, including mixing, dynamics, and signal flow. Experience with digital audio workstations such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Experience with 3D or spatial audio and testing interactive music, dialogue, and ambience. Familiarity with accessibility and gameplay readability considerations, and evaluating audio across different hardware and playback environments. Experience coordinating testing with external QA teams or creating custom test maps and debug tools for audio validation. jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Manager of Broadcast TV Audio Infrastructure assists senior management with responsibilities for the design, operation, maintenance, and strategic development of audio systems while supporting live and recorded television production. This role supports a team of broadcast audio technicians, ensuring reliable, high-quality audio across studios, control rooms, remote productions, and transmission facilities. The manager works closely with production, engineering, IT, and operations teams to support current workflows while planning future technology upgrades.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Audio Infrastructure Management**

* Oversee the operation and maintenance of broadcast audio systems, including intercoms (wired/wireless), audio-over-IP networks, RFOF systems, RF Microphones and IEM monitoring systems.
* Develop and maintain preventative maintenance schedules and system documentation.
* Collaborate with external vendors to prioritize, schedule, and expedite repairs, ensuring maximum system reliability and uptime.

### **Technical Leadership**

* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex audio and broadcast infrastructure issues.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend upgrades to improve efficiency, scalability, and audio quality.
* Collaborate with IT teams on networked audio systems.

### **Project Management**

* Plan and execute capital projects, upgrades, technical work books, equipment refreshes, and system integrations.
* Coordinate installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance of new systems.
* Demoing new audio technologies.

### **Team Leadership**

* Collaborate with upper management to supervise, mentor, and develop broadcast audio engineers and technical staff.
* Coordinate staffing and technical support coverage for live events and special productions.

### 

### **Operational Support**

* Support live broadcast, entertainment, and special event productions.
* Ensure compliance with FCC regulations, company standards, and industry best practices.
* Participate in on-call escalation support for critical broadcast operations.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Engineering, Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in broadcast engineering, professional audio, or television infrastructure environments.
* Extensive knowledge of broadcast audio systems, signal routing, and transmission workflows.
* Understanding Dante platforms.
* Strong understanding of television production environments and live broadcast operations.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting large-scale network television operations.
* Familiarity with broadcast intercom systems.
* Professional certifications in broadcast engineering.
* Experience with wireless communications, and Audio production technologies.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Broadcast systems infrastructure
* Audio engineering expertise
* Project planning and execution
* Problem-solving under pressure
* This role combines broadcast audio engineering expertise with operational leadership to ensure reliable, high-quality audio delivery across all television platforms.

jobs.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

**Job Overview**
----------------

LPL Financial is seeking an **Audio Visual Technician – Audio Engineer** with a strong background in audio engineering and live production to support corporate meetings, executive presentations, town halls, livestreams, and special events.

This role will primarily focus on professional audio production, including live sound mixing, microphone systems, audio signal routing, recording, system configuration, and troubleshooting. The position will also provide general AV and event support, including equipment setup and strike.

The ideal candidate is technically skilled, dependable, customer-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced corporate environment supporting high-visibility events.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

Audio Production & Engineering

* Set up, operate, and troubleshoot professional audio systems for corporate meetings, executive events, town halls, livestreams, and live productions.
* Operate digital audio consoles, wireless microphone systems, playback devices, processors, and related professional audio equipment.
* Mix live audio for in-room audiences, broadcasts, livestreams, recordings, and virtual participants.
* Manage audio signal flow, routing, gain structure, EQ, dynamics processing, and overall system levels.
* Set up and manage wireless lavalier, handheld, podium, and other microphone systems.
* Perform sound checks and ensure clear, consistent audio throughout live events.
* Monitor RF and wireless microphone performance and quickly identify and resolve interference or connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot audio issues including feedback, distortion, signal loss, routing problems, and equipment failures.
* Support audio integration with video conferencing, livestreaming, recording, and broadcast systems.
* Record event audio and assist with media management and archiving as needed.

General AV & Event Support

* Set up, operate, and strike AV equipment for meetings, conferences, and corporate events.
* Provide general support for video systems, displays, projectors, lighting, presentation systems, and video conferencing.
* Set up and strike pipe and drape, staging, and other event production equipment as needed.
* Run, secure, and manage AV cabling while maintaining safe, clean, and professional event spaces.
* Assist with equipment testing, maintenance, inventory, and organization.
* Participate in rehearsals, pre-production meetings, event setup, and post-event breakdown.
* Partner with presenters, executives, producers, event teams, and other AV professionals to deliver a high-quality event experience.

Primary Areas of Responsibility

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

-----------------

* **Live Video Production & Multi-Camera Operation:** minimum of 3 years supporting live corporate events, broadcasts, town halls, or livestreams with hands-on operation of professional cameras, PTZ cameras, and multi-camera production environments.
* **Video Engineering & Signal Flow:** proven experience configuring and troubleshooting video signal routing, switching, distribution, resolutions, and frame rates with strong knowledge of SDI, HDMI, and NDI technologies.
* **Livestreaming & Recording:** experience supporting livestreams, virtual events, encoding, recording, and content distribution and ability to monitor and troubleshoot live productions in real time.
* **Video Switching & Production Equipment:** hands-on experience operating video switchers, routers, recording systems, monitors, and production control equipment.

* Strong post-production and video editing background
* Experience with vMix, OBS, Wirecast, or similar production platforms
* Knowledge of network-based AV/video technology

jobs.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: Ludios About Ludios Ludios takes its name from Latin; it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you. Role Overview As a Sound Designer at Ludios, you'll be responsible for creating, editing, and implementing audio components for our portfolio of games. You will collaborate with our creative teams to craft an immersive audio experience that compliments the game's visuals and gameplay. Key Responsibilities: Create original and engaging sound design for games, including gameplay actions, user interface interactions, animations, rewards, transitions, and other in-game moments. Take ownership of sound design across multiple features and projects, from initial concept through final delivery. Edit, mix, and master audio to produce polished, balanced results across different devices. Collaborate closely with game designers, artists, developers, producers, and other members of the audio team. Communicate effectively with international colleagues, particularly teams based in London, Barcelona, and Australia. Interpret creative briefs, propose suitable audio direction, and respond constructively to feedback. Review audio within the game, identify areas for improvement, and iterate until the sound supports the intended player experience. Organize audio assets and project files clearly, following consistent naming and delivery practices. Manage priorities and deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines. Contribute positively to team discussions and support a collaborative working environment. Requirements : Strong sound design, sound editing, and mixing skills. A good understanding of audio processing, including equalization, compression, dynamics, spatial effects, and level balancing. Proficiency with at least one professional digital audio workstation. Music composition and production skills Ability to create a complete audio experience using sound effects, audio libraries, voice-over, music, recording, layering, and creative processing. A strong ear for detail, timing, tonal balance, and how sound supports visual feedback and the player experience. Openness to learning and adopting new audio tools, technologies, and workflows. Ability to interpret a creative brief and independently develop an appropriate audio direction. Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English. Strong communication and collaboration skills, including confidence working with colleagues across different locations and time zones. Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks or projects. A reliable and constructive approach to teamwork and feedback. Nice to Have Previous experience creating audio for games, particularly mobile or casual games. An understanding of mobile audio limitations, file optimization, loudness, and playback consistency across devices. Experience with collaborative asset-management workflows. Working at Tripledot Hybrid Working 20 days of remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, or use the time to cover mandatory office days to WFH, 20 days of the year. Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements, and our team spirit. Breakfast & Lunch: Relish daily breakfast and lunch provided in the office to keep you fueled and focused. BPJS HEALTH: Elevate your well-being and peace of mind, ensuring robust health security with seamless enrolment in BPJS Health. BPJS SOCIAL: Secure your employment rights with BPJS Social. Festivity Allowance: Celebrate festive occasions with an additional festive allowance. Private Health Insurance: Stay covered with comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones. Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand. Family Forming Support: Receive vital support on your family forming/ fertility journey with our support program [subject to policy] English Classes: Enhance your English skills with our provided English classes View our recruitment privacy policy here
